readme: Registry of note-sets in this repo. tools/check_all.py verifies every number and every page list here against the files on disk, so this file is the closest thing to a table of contents that cannot lie. To work on a topic, add your entry (or claim a planned one) by setting owner and status — that is the whole coordination protocol; see CONTRIBUTING.md.

conventions.folder: one self-contained directory per topic, lowercase-kebab-case
conventions.pages: index.html plus NN-slug.html (NN zero-padded, gaps allowed, order is numeric)
conventions.assets: each topic ships its own assets/ (css, tex.js, notes.js, generated pages.js) so any page opens from file:// with no network
conventions.tools: each topic ships its own tools/ (check.py, mathfix.py, setpages.py, test-tex.js); tools/check_all.py at the root runs the whole gate
conventions.counts: figures/questions/solutions/math are mechanical counts of the markup, recomputed by check_all.py — never hand-edit them

topics.title: String waves — first principles to Olympiad
topics.note: plan.md PART 1 (Agent 1), the head of the wave sequence. Markdown-first. Floor: mechanical waves and the 1-D wave equation from Newton's second law on an element μ dx, v = √(T/μ), d'Alembert's solution, particle velocity versus wave velocity, energy and power transmission, reflection at fixed and free ends, junction coefficients, standing waves and normal modes, sonometer laws and Melde's experiment; olympiad extensions: the hanging rope, WKB amplitude scaling and the phasor sum.
next_candidates: worked-problem companion: the Cengage string-waves exercise sets re-derived with the Part 8 playbook
rotational mechanics and SHM (a natural prerequisite for pendulum/loaded-string coupling)
